Metric comparison

Rank distribution of the held-out positive

Each impression has 21 candidates. Bars on the left mean the model put the held-out game near the top of the ranking.

Why C wins overall but B wins at rank 1. C's LLM descriptions enlarge the encoder's view of each game by ~60 tokens, which helps the model pull the right game into the top-10 (Hit@10 lift) but also adds within-cluster noise that B avoids. So C is better at recall; B is slightly better at precision-at-1. A Steam UI that surfaces a top-10 list benefits directly from C's gain.

Inspect a test impression

Each row shows the top-3 games each condition ranked for one user. Green = the held-out game appears in that condition's top-3.
